pairs: Quod cum audisset Chananæus rex Arad,
And when king Arad the Canaanite,
who was living toward the south,
venisse scilicet Israël per exploratorum viam,
had heard this, namely, that Israel had arrived by the way of spies,
And proving to be the victor,
he led away prey from them.
At Israël voto se Domino obligans,
But Israel, obliging himself by a vow to the Lord,
Si tradideris populum istum in manu mea, delebo urbes ejus.
“If you deliver this people into my hand, I will wipe away their cities.”
And the Lord heard the prayers of Israel,
quem ille interfecit subversis urbibus ejus:
whom they put to death, overthrowing his cities.
et vocavit nomen loci illius Horma,
And they called the name of that place Hormah,
Profecti sunt autem et de monte Hor,
Then they set out from mount Hor,
per viam quæ ducit ad mare Rubrum,
by the way that leads to the Red Sea,
to circle around the land of Edom.
Et tædere cœpit populum itineris ac laboris:
And the people began to tire of their journey and hardships.
And speaking against God and Moses,
“Why did you lead us away from Egypt,
so as to die in the wilderness?
anima nostra jam nauseat super cibo isto levissimo.
Our soul is now nauseous over this very light food.”
Quam ob rem misit Dominus in populum ignitos serpentes,
the Lord sent fiery serpents among the people,
which wounded or killed many of them.
And so they went to Moses,
because we have spoken against the Lord and against you.
ora ut tollat a nobis serpentes.
so that he may take away these serpents from us.”
And Moses prayed for the people.
et locutus est Dominus ad eum:
And the Lord said to him:
and place it as a sign. Whoever,
having been struck, gazes upon it,
Therefore, Moses made a bronze serpent,
and he placed it as a sign.
When those who had been struck gazed upon it,
Profectique filii Israël castrametati sunt in Oboth.
And the sons of Israel, setting out, made camp at Oboth.
Unde egressi fixere tentoria in Jeabarim,
Having departed from there, they pitched their tents at Iye-abarim,
in solitudine quæ respicit Moab contra orientalem plagam.
in the wilderness, which looks out toward Moab, opposite the eastern region.
they arrived at the Torrent of Zared.
Quem relinquentes castrametati sunt contra Arnon,
they then made camp opposite Arnon,
and which juts out at the borders of the Amorite.
For certainly Arnon is at the limit of Moab,
dividing the Moabites and the Amorites.
Unde dicitur in libro bellorum Domini:
About this place, it is said in the book of the wars of the Lord:
“As he did at the Red Sea,
so will he do at the Torrents of Arnon.”
The stones of the torrents were bent,
so that they might rest in Ar
and lie back within the borders of the Moabites.
Beyond that place appeared a well,
super quo locutus est Dominus ad Moysen:
about which the Lord said to Moses:
and I will give them water.”
quem foderunt principes et paraverunt duces multitudinis in datore legis,
and the commanders of the multitude prepared it,
at the direction of the lawgiver,
They went from the wilderness to Mattanah,
from Mattanah to Nahaliel, from Nahaliel to Bamoth,
a valley in the region of Moab,
which looks out opposite the desert.
Misit autem Israël nuntios ad Sehon regem Amorrhæorum,
Then Israel sent messengers to Sihon, the king of the Amorites,
Obsecro ut transire mihi liceat per terram tuam:
“I beg you to permit me to cross through your land.
non declinabimus in agros et vineas;
We will not turn aside into the fields or the vineyards.
We will not drink waters from the wells.
We will travel by the royal way,
until we have passed your borders.”
Qui concedere noluit ut transiret Israël per fines suos:
And he was not willing to allow Israel to cross through his borders.
he went out to meet them in the desert,
and he arrived at Jahaz and fought against them.
A quo percussus est in ore gladii,
And he was struck down by them with the edge of the sword,
et possessa est terra ejus ab Arnon usque Jeboc,
and they possessed his land from Arnon,
even to Jabbok and the sons of Ammon.
quia forti præsidio tenebantur termini Ammonitarum.
For the borders of the Ammonites were held by a strong fortress.
Tulit ergo Israël omnes civitates ejus,
Israel took all his cities and lived in the cities of the Amorite,
Urbs Hesebon fuit Sehon regis Amorrhæi,
Heshbon was the city of Sihon, the king of the Amorites,
who fought against the king of Moab.
And he took all the land,
quæ ditionis illius fuerat usque Arnon.
which had been under his sovereignty, as far as Arnon.
it is said in the proverb:
Let the city of Sihon be established and built.
A fire has gone forth from Heshbon,
a flame from the town of Sihon,
and it has devoured Ar of the Moabites,
and the inhabitants of the heights of Arnon.
You are perishing, O people of Chemosh.
He gave flight to his sons,
et filias in captivitatem regi Amorrhæorum Sehon.
and he gave the daughters into captivity, to the king of the Amorites, Sihon.
Jugum ipsorum disperiit ad Hesebon usque Dibon:
Their yoke has been scattered from Heshbon even to Dibon.
They have passed through, wearily, into Nophah,
Habitavit itaque Israël in terra Amorrhæi.
And so Israel lived in the land of the Amorite.
And Moses sent some to explore Jazer.
And they turned themselves and ascended,
met them with all his people,
Dixitque Dominus ad Moysen: Ne timeas eum,
And the Lord said to Moses: “Do not be afraid of him.
quia in manu tua tradidi illum,
For I have delivered him, and all his people,
et omnem populum ac terram ejus:
as well as his land, into your hand.
And you shall do to him just as you did to Sihon,
the king of the Amorites, the inhabitant of Heshbon.”
Percusserunt igitur et hunc cum filiis suis,
Therefore, they struck him down also, with his sons,
universumque populum ejus usque ad internecionem,
and all his people, even to utter destruction,
